notes: §2002:13.16.38.3 GR12: the exponent of a floating-point edited PICTURE is +9, +99, +999 or +9(n), n = 1 to 3. AnalyzeFloatEdited asks EditionInfo.MaxFloatEditedExponentDigits (3 at COBOL-2002, 4 from 2014); +9.9E+9999 is refused COBOL1658 at --std 2002 and accepted from 2014; +9.9E+999 is accepted (PB5712).
